subject: general
question: Which one among the following languages is one of the six official languages of the United Nations?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chinese**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The United Nations** has** six official languages. Arabic, Chinese, English, French, Russian, and Spanish **are among them.
 
• The right interpretation and translation of these six languages, in both spoken and written form, is critical to the Organization's work because it allows for clear and succinct communication on global concerns.
 
• **The General Assembly (Article 51 of the Rules of Procedure),** **the Economic and Social Council, and the Security Council** all employ these languages at their meetings (Article 41 of its Rules of Procedure).
 
• Each country's delegate may talk in any of the six official languages, or in any language with interpretation in one of the six official languages. 
 
• Official documents are distributed in the six official languages as well. In general, all six languages have equally authoritative texts. English and French are the official working languages of the United Nations Secretariat.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **United Nations:**

 
 
• 
 **Headquarters: New York City, U.S. (international territory)**
 
 
• 
 **Official languages: Arabic, Chinese, English, French, Russian, Spanish**
 
 
• 
 **Type: Intergovernmental organization**
 
 
• 
 **Membership: 193 member states**
 
 
• 
 **Secretary‑General: António Guterres**
 
 
• 
 **Deputy Secretary-General: Amina J. Mohammed**
